fact: GIZ states UNHCR registered more than 32,600 internally displaced persons in five West Region municipalities under the PESOP project, with a survey of about 2,800 households.

ID Tech Wire reports DGSN launched a rapid biometric ID enrolment campaign in the Far North, inaugurated in Maroua, to extend legal identification to displaced people.

fact: Biometric Update reports Cameroon's civil registration law enacted 23 December 2024 lets internally displaced people have lost birth certificates re-issued in their place of residence via the State Counsel.
MINDDEVEL's deck says law 2024/016 takes internally displaced persons into account in issuing or reconstituting civil-status acts.
